limitations: No model, Docker, provider, network or CI execution was performed; this does not attest live service behavior or successful artifact availability.
No secret values were accessed. No results, answers, streams or quality-result directories were read.
q004 question/rubric/source truth and evidence-span correctness are delegated to the separate task-asset review; this review covers the execution contract and corpus-validator connection.
The existing reported 93-test pass was not rerun; additional offline checking targeted old-phase acceptance/selection regression only.
600 seconds is a tool-admission cutoff, not interruption of an already-running tool; the frozen inherited plan explicitly describes this limit.
Hashes identify this reviewed working-tree snapshot. Later freeze or source changes require corresponding review/update; pending hashes and frozen=false are not findings.
